title: Ohm Boy Pineapple Mango Lime 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: The latest addition to Ohm Boy’s Volume II collection is a deliciously sunny medley of the freshest, ripest tropical fruit. The rich, juicy tang of fresh Pineapple collides with mouth-watering Mango, with the zesty edge of squeezed limes adding a thrilling sour kick on the exhale. A great authentic pineapple Dominate tropical fruit flavour, balanced with the sweetness of a ripe mango and delicately finished off with a lip smacking sharp lime. This flavour brings accuracy and a great rounded tropical taste! This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your liking. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered vape mods and sub-ohm tanks.
